rationale: Approved explicitly; the 14-cell H6 fixture stays the evidence base for P1, P2 and P4 and is not rebuilt, while the deduplicated H4 province panel is frozen as the base state of the P3 sweep because H10B showed the per-statement fixed cost dominates the data work on a 14-cell state, which makes a break-even point unobservable there

Approved explicitly; propagation rate is served revisions divided by admitted revisions per run, frozen as a supporting metric and never as a primary metric, and recorded as an addition made after the H9B validation profile

Approved explicitly; 683 of 7666 H4 rows repeat a (cell_id, source_id) pair because two WebAPI variables carry the same indicator, every duplicate group was verified to hold one identical value, and only the duplicates are dropped so the panel satisfies the (cell_id, vintage_id) key required by B3

Approved explicitly; the sweep universe is one indicator-year across all 38 provinces served by a single source, so the largest sweep point is literally one full year for every province and the one-revised-source-per-run rule frozen at H8B holds at every point

Approved explicitly; the proposal specification of 8 vCPU and 16 GB is replaced by the declared praktikum-sd VM with 2 vCPU and 7.7 GiB for every measurement in this article, and the consequence is stated in front: timing is comparative between treatments on identical hardware and is never a performance or scalability claim
